Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.322 (2026-10-28) [testing]
- **BossMod status checks survive a missing or half-loaded BossMod.** Upstream WrathCombo reorganized its BossMod IPC into shared helpers with null-safe fallbacks; that rework (d9c63e468) is merged, so the active-preset module walk, autorotation, custom-queueing, smart-target and AI-targeting checks answer false cleanly when BossMod's rotation window or action queue is absent, instead of erroring partway through the walk.
- BossMod Reborn keeps being read through its own IPC (active preset verdict, AI targeting, manual-queue setting); those reads are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.321 (2026-10-27) [testing]
- **BossMod conflict detection works with current BossMod builds again.** BossMod moved its rotation manager and action-module queue underneath a new window object, so the checks that read the original BossMod's active preset, AI targeting and manual-queue setting found nothing and the preset, AI-targeting and manual-queue verdicts silently came back empty. Those reflection reads now follow the new location, and upstream WrathCombo's matching fix (54e36f2f) is merged; BossMod Reborn keeps being read through its own IPC and is unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.320 (2026-10-24) [testing]
- **The v1.0.4.318 automatic-cleanse change is back, now fenced so the cleanse scan can never hang or spin a frame.** Same cleanse behaviour as before the withdrawal: dispellable debuffs are graded by worth (movement- and action-locking debuffs cleanse first, damage-over-time debuffs cleanse while the healer can spare the cast, damage-taken amplifiers and resist downs never take one, doom always, the dead never), hostile objects can no longer resolve as cleanse candidates anywhere, and one debuff can never consume two casts. New in this build, the cleanse scan runs behind a frame guard: it pauses right after a plugin reload and right after any territory change (the two windows the withdrawn build ran into trouble in), can never re-enter itself, and if a single scan ever costs more than a frame the plugin logs the managed call stack at the slow point and stands the scan down for two seconds instead of repeating next tick.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Supersedes the v1.0.4.319 withdrawal build. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.319 (2026-10-24) [testing]
- **The v1.0.4.318 automatic-cleanse change is withdrawn; cleanse behaviour is again exactly the v1.0.4.317 behaviour.** The change graded dispellable debuffs by worth, required friendly targets along the Esuna retargeting chain and held a second cleanse back while a first was still resolving, but a full game freeze was reported with the build present, the main thread spinning inside the plugin's own managed code, and the exact looping path could not be established from the captured evidence. The whole change comes out rather than leave a suspected hazard on the heal path: the retargeting chain, the worth checks and the double-cast window of v1.0.4.317 are restored as they were.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Supersedes the v1.0.4.318 testing build, which is withdrawn. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.318 (2026-10-24) [testing]
- **Automatic cleanses (Esuna and Exuviation) now fire only when the debuff is worth the cast, and never twice for the same debuff.** Three defects fixed at one shared verdict. First, the Esuna retargeting chain could resolve a hostile target: a mob carrying its own dispel-flagged damage-over-time effect (for example Combust III on the mob the DoT was cast on) outranked the real party member, so grinding a FATE could spend global cooldowns casting Esuna at a mob. The chain now requires a friendly target at every step, and hostile objects can no longer resolve as cleanse candidates anywhere. Second, the heal-combo cleanse branch and the auto-rotation's party cleanse were two independent casters for the same debuff while the status list still showed a debuff that a cast already in flight was removing, so one debuff could consume two casts seconds apart. Every cleanse send now goes through one shared verdict that remembers a cleanse sent in the last few seconds and stands down until it resolves. Third, every dispellable status was treated as equally worth a cast. The verdict now grades them: movement- and action-locking debuffs cleanse first, because cleansing them is the dodge; damage-over-time debuffs cleanse while the healer is healthy enough to spare the cast; damage-taken amplifiers and resist downs that fall off on their own never take one. Under low health only a cleansing doom is still worth the cast, and a dead candidate is never targeted.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.317 (2026-10-21) [testing]
- **The Cast-Start Stillness setting is removed, together with the v1.0.4.316 testing build it shipped in.** That build held a fresh cast bar for a moment after movement stopped to keep the bar from being glued onto a dodge, but casting into a stop is normal cast mechanics, not a stuck slide-cast, so the hold answered a problem the game does not have. Cast-start movement behaviour is again exactly the v1.0.4.315 behaviour: moving always blocks a new cast start, instant casts and orbwalker-driven movement never block, and a stopped player casts immediately. The v1.0.4.315 FATE-grind spike skip is untouched. A settings file that still carries the old key loads unchanged; the key is ignored and disappears at the next save.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Supersedes the v1.0.4.316 testing build, which is withdrawn. Not verified in play yet.
